acceptanceCriteria: The integrity gate dynamically discovers active and archived Work Items without a hard-coded WI range.
The gate emits an auditable JSON receipt with deterministic findings and fails closed on an unregistered broken link.
Historical or legacy records are explicitly classified and do not masquerade as current release failures.
Regression fixtures cover missing Work Item, missing evidence, missing close, historical exemption, and unknown problem cases.
Documentation parity and workflow/release/conformance/performance gates are invoked in CI without duplicate conflicting execution.
Workspace package test coverage is derived from cargo metadata and fails when a package is omitted.
Only tests, docs, and GitHub workflow files are changed; no crates are changed.
goal: Enumerate repository governance records and execute all applicable quality gates so missing Work Item links, evidence, lifecycle receipts, documentation parity, workflow checks, and workspace package coverage fail closed.
intent: Prevent CI from silently accepting unregistered governance defects by adding a dynamic problem inventory and integrity gate.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A newly introduced Work Item is discovered without editing an ID list.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the gate against a fixture containing an additional WI id and assert the generated inventory includes it.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Missing evidence or close linkage produces a deterministic failed finding.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run regression fixtures that remove evidence and close files and assert non-zero exit plus JSON findings.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Explicit legacy classification is reported and does not become a current release failure.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a fixture with a historical exemption and assert the result is classified historical with no current-failure finding.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Every workspace package and every declared quality gate is covered exactly once.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare cargo metadata package names and gate manifest entries, then run the gate's duplicate and omission fixtures.
